description: Hermes provider-resolution config. Replaces NovelKit's legacy provider stack (llm_config.py + gemini_key_pool.py + gemini_pool_status.py + google_genai_compat.py) and the CONTRACTS.md §4 Provider Failover Contract (finding D6). Actual provider resolution, credential pools and alias handling are delegated to Hermes runtime_provider; this file only declares the creative-lane policy + ordered failover preference. NovelKit ships no provider HTTP clients of its own.
_wiring_note: This declarative failover chain (primary + fallbacks + LLM_* env_overrides) is ONLY consumed when a Hermes runtime_provider is mounted. The in-repo prose path (integrations/autonovel/llm_loop.py -> provider/llm_client.py) reads provider/settings.py, which uses the NOVELKIT_LLM_BASE_URL / NOVELKIT_LLM_MODEL / NOVELKIT_LLM_API_KEY namespace and a single endpoint (no failover). Do not expect LLM_PROVIDER/LLM_FALLBACKS to affect in-repo generation.

creative_lane.note: When changing provider/model for the creative lane, review the latest Style Coherence Audit before a long run so a model swap does not introduce prose drift (CONTRACTS §4). The drift report does not override review scores.
